Welcome—I'm really glad you're here. Have you ever noticed how we tend to tiptoe around the topic of death, almost as if speaking about it makes it more real? Well, together, we're about to step into a space where that silence is broken, and curiosity takes the lead.
In Smoke Gets in Your Eyes & Other Lessons from the Crematory, Caitlin Doughty invites us to look honestly at mortality—no more hiding behind closed doors or whispered conversations. We'll join her as she navigates life and work inside a crematory, where the line between the living and the dead isn’t as clear as we might think.
What if, instead of shrinking away from our fears about death, we leaned in and allowed ourselves to really see what happens? Through stories that mix humor, vulnerability, and sometimes surprising tenderness, we'll discover how rituals and cultural attitudes shape the way we mourn, remember, and eventually heal.
Along the way, Caitlin’s perspective will challenge us to rethink what it means to live fully, even in the presence of impermanence. This isn’t just a book about crematories or funerals—it’s an invitation to see the profound connections and unexpected lessons that come from facing mortality with open eyes.
So, as we begin this journey, let’s set aside discomfort and approach the unknown with a bit more openness. Together, we’ll explore how understanding death can actually bring us closer to life itself.
